Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek: Enable headset on Lenovo M90 Gen5

Lenovo M90 Gen5 is equipped with ALC897, and it needs
ALC897_FIXUP_HEADSET_MIC_PIN quirk to make its headset mic work.
